svg.title: Layers from open plot to contained rooms — preliminary bubble study

g.text: Colours describe spatial conditions, not functions. The same numbers follow the journey in plan and section.
True plot geometry · north up · metres
Solid edge = plot. Dashed edge = 4 m inset.
Coloured block = 17 × 24 m outer test envelope.
Entry porch / upper overlaps stay inside this block.
Building axes rotated for reading · bubbles are NOT area allocations
Still outside: arrive, pause, choose a door.
Under cover, but not yet in a closed room.
A common space connects different activities.
Cross another threshold into a smaller space.
The south arrival remains outside first.
A porch leads into a shared interior,
then small rooms nest along its edge.
Risk: a corridor with rooms attached.
Test each shared pocket as a place to stay,
not just a route through the building.
03 / A–A: ONE BUILDING, WITH OPEN GROUND BEFORE IT
Ground journey matches the plan above. Upper relationships remain schematic; this is not a final room or floor-area schedule.
Shared landings sit beside smaller rooms.
G / Porch → shared hall → smaller rooms
East ramp is out of this cut; lift returns to shared welcome.
Core projected from the eastern side.
VERIFY B1 counting, ramp, exits and capacity.
14 m schematic body; 17 m brief cap.
408 m² outer footprint / 27.4% of plot · 4 m inset checked · about 1,080 m² remains outside the envelope.
Open land is not all planted or public. Ramp, B1, floor counting, room areas, fire access and final coverage remain to be resolved.
